speed.name: Speed
speed.text: How fast you move: 6% faster a point over 3.

sense.name: Sense
sense.text: Treasure and monsters within (4 + Sense) cells show on your map, through walls.

physical.name: Physical
physical.text: Health (100 at 3, 20 a point) and the room in your pack (2 a point).

mental.name: Mental
mental.text: Every hack: 5% better a point over 3.

mechanics.name: Mechanics
mechanics.text: Machines: shutting them down, starting them up, putting them right. Panel options that need it say how much.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.text: Healing: 15% more from every health pack and station a rank.

human.name: Human
human.text: The average, which out here is an achievement. 100 health, nothing to apologize for.

hyena.name: Mutant Hyena
hyena.text: An Evolved Hyena: smaller, weaker, faster, sharper. 80 health, 18% faster, and you sense things 10 cells away.

mutant.name: Random Mutant
mutant.text: Human-ish, plus one to three mutations from the wastes. Some help, some don't. You see the roll, and you can roll again once.

chitin.name: Chitin Plates
chitin.text: Natural armour: 10% off every hit. Speed -1.

arm.name: Third Arm
arm.text: A third hand: hold one more weapon.

glow.name: Glowing Skin
glow.text: You light up the dark (your lamp reaches half as far again). Sense -1.
